stories.title: Deutsche Bank sees RBI repo rate at 6.25% by mid‑2027
stories.summary: Deutsche Bank expects the Reserve Bank of India to raise its repo rate to 6.25% by mid‑2027. The bank points to persistent inflation, forecasting average CPI inflation of about 6% in late 2026 and easing to 4.7% by FY28. It also projects India’s GDP growth remaining above 7% in FY27 and FY28.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.

stories.title: General Compute raises $100 million Series A at $800 million valuation
stories.summary: General Compute announced a $100 million Series A round led by Blackbird Ventures and Abstract Ventures, bringing its post‑money valuation to about $800 million. The round follows a $100 million annual recurring revenue contract with a large customer and a $400 million chip purchase agreement with SambaNova, and adds supply from Positron and Cerebras. The company builds its AI inference cloud using specialized inference chips and repurposed bitcoin‑mining sites rather than large proprietary data centers.
stories.why: The funding gives capital to a niche AI inference‑chip cloud provider as the market questions the sustainability of larger “neocloud” models.

stories.title: Jordan carries out deadly strike in Syria in retaliation for church attack
stories.summary: Syrian health officials told state media five people, including women, children and an elderly man, were killed in the strike on a village in the southern Daraa province. Jordan said its fighter jets had killed and wounded "several terrorists", without giving further details.

stories.title: RBI steps up liquidity support as tighter cash conditions push up borrowing rates: Report
stories.summary: Tightening liquidity in the banking system has pushed up short-term borrowing rates, prompting the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to inject funds into banks, according to an ICICI Bank report. The report expects the 10-year benchmark bond yield to trade between 7.40% and 7.60% in the near term.
